workbench_lsp_action_docs: Language server popover button that opens the docs
workbench_lsp_action_failed: Toast when a code action fails; title is the action's name
workbench_lsp_action_log: Language server popover button that opens the server log

workbench_lsp_cmd_rename: Command palette entry and title of the rename prompt
workbench_lsp_command_copied: Toast after copying the install command
workbench_lsp_crashed: Chip label of a language server that stopped

workbench_lsp_custom_not_found: Chip label when the custom server command does not exist
workbench_lsp_group_quick_fixes: Group of the quick fixes in the code actions picker
